name: @wirecat/bitrix24-cli
description: Read and change a Bitrix24 portal's CRM — deals, leads, contacts, companies — from the terminal, scripts and AI agents
author: Viacheslav Ptsarev

scripts.test:matrix: vitest run >/dev/null && pnpm build >/dev/null && pnpm test:matrix:check
scripts.test:matrix:check: cli-dev test-matrix --program scripts/command-program.ts --untested scripts/test-matrix-untested.ts --name b24 --check && git diff --exit-code -- docs/dev/test-matrix.md
scripts.generate: pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/commands.ts && cli-dev manifest --program dist/program.js --identity dist/wcat.js
scripts.generate:check: pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/commands.ts --check && cli-dev manifest --program dist/program.js --identity dist/wcat.js --check
scripts.docs:check: cli-dev docs-check --rules scripts/docs-rules.ts --pages && pnpm docs:spell && rumdl check --config config/wirecat/rumdl.toml README.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md docs/*.md docs/dev/*.md && pnpm docs:lint
scripts.ci:quick: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm lint:commands
scripts.release:check: pnpm standards:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm lint:commands && pnpm audit:commands && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm contracts:upgrade && pnpm test:matrix:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm generate:check && pnpm version:check && pnpm security:no-leak && pnpm package:check
scripts.docs:spell: cspell lint --config cspell.json --no-progress --no-summary README.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md 'docs/*.md' 'skills/**/*.md'
